hs_sym_headache.text: A headache has been camping behind your eyes for three days. Light feels personal.

outcomes.helped: The ginger-and-mint smoothie seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The ginger-and-mint smoothie does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.diag: Migraines. The doctor hands you a leaflet and a dark room.
outcomes.fine: Tension, caffeine, and not enough water. You leave with advice and a lighter wallet.

hs_sym_rash.text: A red, itchy rash blooms on your forearm. It has opinions about your sleep.

outcomes.helped: The oatmeal-and-honey paste seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The oatmeal-and-honey paste does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.fine: An allergic reaction to something. Cream, and a list of suspects.
outcomes.bad: A stubborn infection. Antibiotics, and a week of itching in silence.

hs_sym_chest.text: Your chest feels tight on the stairs, like someone is sitting on it politely.

outcomes.helped: The beet-and-garlic smoothie seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The beet-and-garlic smoothie does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.diag: High blood pressure. Pills, salt rules and a stern look.
outcomes.fine: Anxiety plus a pulled muscle. Relief, and a mild lecture.

hs_sym_vision.text: The words on your screen smear at the edges. You blame the screen.

outcomes.helped: The carrot-and-orange smoothie seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The carrot-and-orange smoothie does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.glasses: You need glasses. The world sharpens and so does your regret about waiting.
outcomes.fine: Dry eyes and screen fatigue. Drops, and a rule about breaks.

hs_sym_numb.text: Your right hand goes numb every morning, fingers fizzing like soda.

outcomes.helped: The turmeric smoothie seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The turmeric smoothie does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.splint: Nerve pressure from how you sit and type. A wrist brace and stretching homework.
outcomes.fine: Slept on it wrong, repeatedly. Better pillow, better mornings.

hs_sym_cough.text: A dry cough that will not leave. It has outlasted two rounds of small talk.

outcomes.helped: The honey-lemon-ginger smoothie seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The honey-lemon-ginger smoothie does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.diag: Bronchitis. Rest, fluids, and an inhaler for good measure.
outcomes.viral: A lingering virus. Rest and patience, and the cough finally packs up.

hs_sym_insomnia.text: You lie awake until the birds start. Your brain reviews every embarrassing thing you ever said.

outcomes.helped: The chamomile-banana smoothie seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The chamomile-banana smoothie does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.diag: Chronic insomnia. Sleep hygiene rules and a very small pill.
outcomes.fine: Stress and screens. A routine, a curfew for your phone, and some actual sleep.

hs_sym_back.text: You bend to tie a shoe and your lower back files a formal complaint.

outcomes.helped: The anti-inflammatory berry smoothie seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The anti-inflammatory berry smoothie does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.diag: A bad disc. Physio, a better chair, and a lifelong relationship with stretching.
outcomes.strain: A strained muscle. Heat, rest, and it fades in a week.

hs_sym_dizzy.text: The room tilts when you stand up too fast. You steady yourself on a bookshelf.

outcomes.helped: The spinach-and-iron smoothie seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The spinach-and-iron smoothie does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.diag: Anemia. Iron tablets and a list of foods that taste like pennies.
outcomes.fine: Low blood pressure and not enough water. Eat, drink, stand slowly.

hs_sym_ear.text: Your ear throbs with a hot, deep ache. Everything sounds like it is underwater.

outcomes.helped: The garlic-oil warm compress seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The garlic-oil warm compress does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.diag: An ear infection. Drops, rest, and a week of shouting everything twice.
outcomes.wax: Wax buildup. A quick flush and the world returns in HD.

hs_sym_flu.text: Chills, aches, and a fever that makes your own bed feel like a boat.

outcomes.helped: The hot lemon-honey-ginger smoothie seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The hot lemon-honey-ginger smoothie does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.diag: The flu. Fluids and rest, and a note to cancel your plans.
outcomes.cold: A heavy cold. You sleep for two days and wake up humanoid again.

hs_sym_stomach.text: Stomach cramps arrive in waves. The bathroom door has become your best friend.

outcomes.helped: The papaya-and-fiber smoothie seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The papaya-and-fiber smoothie does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.diag: Chronic constipation. Fiber, water, and a talk about patience.
outcomes.fine: Food poisoning from something you ate. Rest and liquids, and a vow about that sushi.

hs_sym_flank.text: A knifing pain in your side doubles you over. You hold the wall and bargain.

outcomes.helped: The cucumber-and-lemon flush smoothie seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The cucumber-and-lemon flush smoothie does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.diag: Kidney stones. Everyone who has had them compares it to childbirth.
outcomes.fine: A kidney infection. Antibiotics, rest, and a lot of water.

hs_sym_tired.text: You are tired in a way sleep does not touch. Even coffee seems tired.

outcomes.helped: The green-juice smoothie seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The green-juice smoothie does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.diag: Anemia. Iron and rest bring the colour back slowly.
outcomes.fine: Overwork and a bad diet. The blood work is clean, the lifestyle is not.

hs_sym_mole.text: A mole on your shoulder looks different. Bigger, darker, a little smug.

outcomes.helped: The aloe-and-vitamin-E rub seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The aloe-and-vitamin-E rub does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.benign: Benign. They check it, say it is fine, and tell you to wear sunscreen.
outcomes.removed: Caught early. They cut it out and it never becomes a story.

hs_sym_flutter.text: Your heart skips like a stone on a lake, once, twice, then carries on like nothing happened.

outcomes.helped: The hibiscus-and-banana smoothie seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The hibiscus-and-banana smoothie does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.diag: Borderline blood pressure. Daily pills and a salt shaker confiscated.
outcomes.fine: Caffeine and stress. Cut the third espresso and the skipping stops.

hs_sym_ringing.text: A high thin ringing in your ears, even in silence. Especially in silence.

outcomes.helped: The ginkgo-and-mint tea seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The ginkgo-and-mint tea does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.tinnitus: Tinnitus. There's no cure, only coping tricks and a white noise machine.
outcomes.fine: Earwax and loud concerts catching up. Rest your ears and it settles.

hs_sym_tooth.text: A tooth throbs every time you drink anything cold. You chew on the left now, like a pirate.

outcomes.helped: The clove-oil dab seems to help. Or you've just stopped noticing.
outcomes.nothing: The clove-oil dab does nothing except make the kitchen smell.
outcomes.filling: A cavity. Drill, filling, and a judgmental dental hygienist.
outcomes.root: An abscess. Root canal, antibiotics, and a bill with a lot of zeros.

hs_ail_flare.text: Your condition flares up without warning, mid-week, mid-plan.

outcomes.crash: You crash hard. Your body sends the bill.
outcomes.adjusted: A new dose, a kinder routine, breathing room.
outcomes.same: Same advice, same pills, new invoice.

hs_ail_second_opinion.text: You wonder if the diagnosis was the whole story. A second opinion costs money and nerve.

outcomes.cured: A different doctor finds a different answer, and it works. You nearly cry in the parking lot.
outcomes.same: Same diagnosis, same treatment, but now you believe it.
outcomes.worse: The second doctor adds a complication. Great.

hs_ail_quack.text: A website promises a miracle cure for your condition. It's $300, with a smiling doctor in a stock photo.

outcomes.scam: A box of sugar pills arrives. You hold the receipt like a prayer.
outcomes.placebo: The placebo effect is generous. You feel better, and poorer.
outcomes.toxic: Something in it disagrees with you violently.

hs_ail_acceptance.text: Years in, the illness is part of the furniture. You can fight it, or learn its habits.

outcomes.good: A circle of folding chairs and people who get it. You didn't know how heavy it was until it was lighter.
outcomes.meh: Awkward biscuits, nothing else. Maybe next time.

hs_ail_side_effects.text: The pills help, but they come with a rainbow of side effects. Dry mouth, drowsy eyes, odd dreams.

outcomes.better: A different brand, fewer symptoms. Why did you wait?
outcomes.none: There isn't a gentler option yet.
outcomes.rebound: The condition rushes back like it's been waiting at the door.

hs_ail_insurance.text: The insurer denied your claim for the treatment. Seven pages of reasons, none of them medical.

outcomes.won: They cave after three letters and a phone call that makes a clerk sigh.
outcomes.lost: Denied again. You pay and mutter.

hs_ail_sick_day.text: You wake up wrecked. Calling in sick feels like a confession.

outcomes.fine: You cough through the meeting. The boss nods approvingly.
outcomes.worse: Everyone avoids you for fear of contagion.

hs_ail_miracle_diet.text: A relative swears a strict juice diet cured their own ailment. They have a spreadsheet.

outcomes.helps: Weight drops, energy lifts, symptoms ease. Anecdote one.
outcomes.nothing: You're hungry, grumpy, and exactly as ill as before.
outcomes.worse: Your body protests the lack of food by getting worse.

hs_ail_hospital_bill.text: The hospital bill arrives. It has a line item for a single aspirin that costs more than lunch.

outcomes.cut: After a long call you shave off half. Victory, in a way.
outcomes.same: The clerk is sympathetic and immovable.

hs_ail_trial.text: A clinic invites you into a drug trial for your condition. Free care, possible placebo.

outcomes.cured: You got the real drug. Months later, the symptoms are gone and your pockets slightly fuller.
outcomes.placebo: Sugar pills, free coffee, and a feeling of being useful.
outcomes.reaction: A bad reaction ends your participation and ruins your week.

hs_mh_burnout.text: Monday looms like a locked room. You stare at the screen and nothing comes. This isn't tired; it's empty.

outcomes.ok: You muddle through. It's grey, but you're upright.
outcomes.crash: The weekend ends and something stays broken.
outcomes.kind: They're surprisingly decent. You lighten your load.
outcomes.cold: They hear you and then give you more work.

hs_mh_panic.text: Your hands tingle. The room folds in. You can't breathe, you're sure of it, until you can.

outcomes.passes: Four in, four out. It passes like a storm.
outcomes.again: It rolls back in. You manage it, barely.

hs_mh_therapy.text: A friend suggests therapy. You like your problems; they keep you company.

outcomes.helps: After a few sessions you name things you never named. It feels like lifting a lid.
outcomes.mismatch: The therapist and you do not click. Expensive silence.

hs_mh_therapy_depressed.text: The fog has stayed for months. Someone leaves a number on your table without a word.

outcomes.better: You show up. Slowly, things shift. It is not a miracle, just a Tuesday that feels lighter.
outcomes.hard: The first sessions are hard. You stay anyway.

hs_mh_friend_noticed.text: {{name}} stops you mid-sentence. 'You haven't been yourself. What's going on?'

outcomes.lighter: {{name}} listens without fixing anything. It is exactly what you needed.
outcomes.awkward: It comes out clumsy but it comes out.

hs_mh_good_day.text: For no reason, the morning feels okay. The sun is a color you recognize.

outcomes.lift: One good day becomes three. You are climbing out.
outcomes.fade: It fades by evening, but you saw it. You know it exists.

hs_mh_sleepless_worry.text: At 3 a.m. your thoughts schedule a meeting. Agenda: everything.

outcomes.kind: They answer groggy and kind. You feel less alone.
outcomes.annoyed: They're furious. You weren't wrong to wonder.

hs_mh_loneliness.text: The apartment is very quiet tonight, and your phone is quieter.

outcomes.reply: Someone answers fast, as if they were waiting for you to say something first.
outcomes.silence: No reply. The silence is loud tonight.

hs_life_diet.text: New year, new diet. Your fridge is already looking at you with suspicion.

outcomes.success: Three months later your clothes fit differently and so does your mood.
outcomes.quit: By week three you are eating cake at midnight. Your fridge wins.

hs_life_sleep.text: You've been running on five hours for months. Your body starts leaving notes.

outcomes.good: Lights out at eleven. The world looks inexplicably sharper.
outcomes.relapse: You relapse by Thursday. Old habits sleep lightly.

hs_life_fitness_challenge.text: A friend dares you to run a 5K. You haven't run since a bus was involved.

outcomes.finish: You cross the line wheezing and proud. They give you a banana.
outcomes.injury: A knee tweaks at kilometer two. You limp home.

hs_life_checkup50.text: It has been years since a real checkup. The nurse says your name like a verdict.

outcomes.clear: Everything is fine. You buy yourself a pastry out of gratitude.
outcomes.caught: Pressure's high, cholesterol too. Better to know now.
outcomes.scare: A shadow on the scan. They need more tests. The waiting is the worst part.

hs_life_screening.text: A reminder letter for screening sits unopened on the table. It sits there like a stern uncle.

outcomes.early: They find something small and early. It gets removed, and the odds turn in your favor.
outcomes.late: It's further along than hoped. A long road starts here.

hs_life_dry_month.text: You try a month without alcohol. Evenings become strangely long.

outcomes.great: You sleep better, wake clearer, and notice how much you used to spend.
outcomes.fail: Day 11, a friend's birthday, a glass. Day 12, you give up the project.

hs_life_hike.text: A friend drags you up a hill 'for the view'. The view is mostly your own knees.

outcomes.view: The summit hits. Wind, sky, a sandwich that tastes like winning.
outcomes.sprain: Your ankle rolls on the way down. The view was still nice.

hs_life_cooking.text: A cooking class promises to teach you to make real meals that don't come from a box.

hs_old_hearing.text: Everyone seems to mumble these days. You've started answering the wrong question with confidence.

hs_old_fall.text: A rug, a slipper, and the floor comes up fast. You lie there counting your limbs.

outcomes.fine: You rise, bruised and proud. Nobody needs to know.
outcomes.break: Something snaps, and standing becomes a rumor.

hs_old_memory.text: You walk into a room and forget why. Then a name. Then a street you've lived on for forty years.

outcomes.normal: Normal aging. The doctor says so twice.
outcomes.early: Early memory loss. There are things to do, and there is time.

hs_old_pacemaker.text: Your heart skips too slow. The cardiologist suggests a pacemaker. You joke about being remote controlled.

outcomes.good: A small device, a big difference. You climb stairs again.
outcomes.complication: An infection around the device. Painful and costly, but you recover.
outcomes.death: Something goes wrong on the table. The lights dim.
outcomes.ok: You manage with pills and care. For now.
outcomes.collapse: You collapse at the market. They admit you after all.

hs_old_cataract.text: The world has a milky film over it. Faces, signs, even the news seem foggy.

outcomes.clear: Twenty minutes later, colors are brighter than you remembered.
outcomes.meh: The result is only fine, and slow to settle.

hs_old_pills.text: Your medicine drawer has become a pharmacy of its own. Last week you took one twice and another never.

outcomes.cut: The doctor drops three pills nobody remembers starting.
outcomes.same: Everything stays. The drawer stays heavy.
